dialogues.name: Anne Acqanda
dialogues.dialogue: Hello there, do you have any business with me? I’m trying to keep watch on the prices, so if you have any commonplace inquiries, please direct them to someone more.. at your level?

dialogues.name: Anne Acqanda
dialogues.dialogue: Why, I’m glad you’re here friend! These prices are insane! Quite the steal for such an extraordinary ability, is it not? I watched “Back to the Future” and always dreamed of doing what they did! Will I be able to do it for real?

dialogues.name: Geoff Sterling
dialogues.dialogue: I’ll have to contact the company; it seems like I may have enough funds to win! Wait, why am I sharing this with a commoner? Go back to your “partying” and save the real work for us! giggles excitedly as he sees the prices fall.

dialogues.name: Geoff Sterling
dialogues.dialogue: Oh! Joyous day it is! You know the prize, don’t you!? Time. Travel. Ahaha! The Temporistic Foundation really does create marvels! I’ll have a vacation in Hawaii, Bali, and Rome all in a day! Heh heh heh! What’s up with that old fart in our posse, tho?

dialogues.name: Maria Caloz
dialogues.dialogue: Ohoho! You are simply a partygoer, yes? Can you use your inferior tastebuds to try this dish? I do not want to get my tongue, eh, dirtied if this is not well made. No? Do not waste my time.

dialogues.name: Maria Caloz
dialogues.dialogue: You must try this first delight! It is quite, as we would say, the “BOMB!” Ahaha! It tastes so delicate, so delicious, that it feels like the NINE realms are expanding! What a heavenly experience.

dialogues.name: Jeremy Femurspyne
dialogues.dialogue: Quite the elitists aren’t they, those investors and artisans. I’d love to rip into them..have a little taste of their bones… Argh, pay me no mind. I should keep my mouth shut lest you be one of their ilk.. If you’re truly one of us..well, I’ll figure it out in due time.

dialogues.name: Jeremy Femurspyne
dialogues.dialogue: I can see past your front, friend. You’re no simple partygoer, but you’re no nobility, are you? No no no, you’re something more special. An exception. How did I know? I can smell you. Don’t worry, I won’t go tattling. To tell you the truth, I’m no simple partygoer either. We are both the exceptions, aren’t we? Playing our false roles just so long as it suits us.

dialogues.name: Randolph Ferguson
dialogues.dialogue: I can tell you have never sauteed a seal tail before. Get to yapping with the other mangy dogs they call “partygoers!” (mumbles to himself): “I cannot believe TUFF is part of our crew.”

dialogues.name: Randolph Ferguson
dialogues.dialogue: My my, an esteemed gentleman from the club! Our other new member Maria has been entertaining us with quite the stories all night! Her talent is to die for, and not to mention, she handles gunpowder as an accent in wine quite masterfully.

dialogues.name: Karen Soiree
dialogues.dialogue: OMG, HAIII! Ew, you’re not one of those rich hoity toity kids are ya? Your style is so lame. Come back when you have some actual flair. (she criticizes the elitists, yet is one herself?)

dialogues.name: Karen Soiree
dialogues.dialogue: Woah! Your face looks awesome! I mean, its really pretty generic man! But at least you got some of the designs to match ours! I knew you weren’t one of those richy richies. Hey, have you seen Henry Callinger? He’s pretty cool. He’s got nice moves!

dialogues.name: Margaret Vinewaters
dialogues.dialogue: Oh dear, oh dear. I hope my friends weren’t rude to you. They don’t see non investors as important sometimes, that time travel business has got them loony. Well, I’ll let you get back to the party.

dialogues.name: Margaret Vinewaters
dialogues.dialogue: Oh dear, an old woman like me in a job like this, they’d never know a thing, haha! The other investors thought it was crazy and said I was “blowing myself up” and getting too big for my britches. But you know, I’m the second oldest person in the room, my luck is TWOfold!

dialogues.name: Henry Callinger
dialogues.dialogue: Smashin’ party innit? Ya know, you don’t look too snazzy, I reckon you’re a partygoer yourself? Eh, nah, ya look too fancy, but I guess anything’s possible. Blasted Donald Tuff’s dressed like he’s about to go surfing and he’s s’posed to be a culinary aficionado. Weirdos.

dialogues.name: Henry Callinger
dialogues.dialogue: Now, I’ve looked around this room for the third time, checking out who’s who. And between you and me mate, I only think about SIX of em are trustworthy. The other three? Well, who gives a rat’s tushie? They can all blow for all I care.

dialogues.name: Donald Tuff
dialogues.dialogue: Sup, broski. Burps I just took a NASTY swig of this punch, and it isn’t calming me down! I don’t even wanna talk to you, you look like you’re just gonna hic ruin my funk, you know? Now buzz off, I need another drink.

dialogues.name: Donald Tuff
dialogues.dialogue: To tell you the truth, I look like a partygoer, but I’m really a culinary aficionado. Ferguson hates me, but he’s just a buzzkill yo. I got the title of aficionado from eating 4 whole cakes in 5 minutes during high school, heh.

dialogues.name: Peter A. Netter
dialogues.dialogue: I’m Peter! Oh, no no! Not that Peter. I’m Peter A. Netter, Anteater for short. Why am I here? Eh, I don’t know. I’m a reference person, or maybe just a reference? You tell me.
